title: StageReceipt
description: Mirrors a2a_compliance.lifecycle.StageReceipt exactly: role, capability, status, action_digest, input_digest, output_digest, reason. The __post_init__ invariants of that dataclass (NOT_APPLICABLE needs a reason whose stripped form is non-empty; SATISFIED needs a truthy output_digest, i.e. non-null and non-empty) are re-expressed here as schema conditionals, matching the dataclass's own tests (`reason.strip()`, `not output_digest`) rather than mere field presence, so a wire-level tamper cannot bypass them.

role.description: must match lifecycle.TOOL_OWNERS[capability] when capability is a tool: capability
